chaos_elemental/.text: Is it true a level 3 skiller caught one of your siblings?
Yes, they killed my mummy, kidnapped my brother, smiled about it and went to sleep.
Aww, well you have me now! I shall call you Squishy and you shall be mine and you shall be my Squishy.
Come on, Squishy come on, little Squishy!

dagannoth_supreme/.text: Hey, so err... I kind of own you now.
Tsssk. Next time you enter those caves, human, my father will be having words.
Maybe next time I'll add your brothers to my collection.

dagannoth_prime/.text: So despite there being three kings, you're clearly the leader, right?
I'm glad I got you as a pet.
Ugh. Human, I'm not a pet.

dagannoth_rex/.text: Do you have any berserker rings?
So, if I tipped you upside down and shook you, you'd not drop any berserker rings?
What if I endlessly killed your father for weeks on end, would I get one then?

penance_queen/.text: Of all the high gamble rewards I could have won, I won you...
Keep trying, human. You'll never win that Dragon Chainbody.

kreearra/.text: Huh... that's odd... I thought that would be big news.
You thought what would be big news?
Well there seems to be an absence of a certain ornithological piece: a headline regarding mass awareness of a certain avian variety.
Oh have you not heard? It was my understanding that everyone had heard....
OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD. OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD.
There's a slight pause as Kree'Arra Jr. goes stiff.

general_graardor/.text: Not sure this is going to be worth my time but... how are you?

kril_tsutsaroth/.text: You seem much nicer than your father. He's mean.
If you were stuck in a very dark cave for centuries you'd be pretty annoyed too.

baby_mole/mole.text: Hey, Mole. How is life above ground?
Well, the last time I was above ground, I was having to contend with people throwing snow at some weird yellow duck in my park.
No idea, I didn't stop to ask as an angry mob was closing in on them pretty quickly.

baby_mole/mole-rat.text: Hey, Mole. How is life above ground?
Well, the last time I was above ground, I was having to contend with people throwing snow at some weird yellow duck in my park.
No idea, I didn't stop to ask as an angry mob was closing in on them pretty quickly.

prince_black_dragon/.text: Shouldn't a prince only have two heads?
Well, a standard Black dragon has one, the King has three so inbetween must have two?

kalphite_princess/walking.text: What is it with your kind and potato cactus?
Soup. We make a fine soup with it.
Nah, we just collect it and put it there because we know fools like yourself will come down looking for it then inevitably be killed by my mother.
Evidently not, that's how I got you!

nodes.text: So where's the fire?
I don't have a fire.
No smoke without fire!
Please stop, human.

opts.label: So you don't cause lung disease?

nodes.text: So you don't cause lung disease?
We're safe if you don't inhale.
Good to know.

opts.label: So you don't leave soot everywhere?

nodes.text: So you don't leave soot everywhere?
Would you defecate on the floor like a camel? Neither would I. So no, I do not leave soot everywhere.
That's nice of you.
Never mind.

kraken/.text: How are you actually walking on land?
We have another leg, just below the center of our body that we use to move across solid surfaces.

dark_core/corporeal critter.text: Something where you eat the outside and throw the core away!

snakeling/green.text: Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
Zulrah's wilderness as a God will soon be demonstrated.

snakeling/magma.text: Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
Zulrah's wilderness as a God will soon be demonstrated.

snakeling/tanzanite.text: Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
Zulrah's wilderness as a God will soon be demonstrated.

venenatis_spiderling/regular.text: It's a damn good thing I don't have arachnophobia.
We're misunderstood. Without us in your house, you'd be infested with flies and other REAL nasties.

venenatis_spiderling/legacy.text: It's a damn good thing I don't have arachnophobia.
We're misunderstood. Without us in your house, you'd be infested with flies and other REAL nasties.

callisto_cub/regular.text: You should get in the.... sun more.
One second, let me take a picture of you with my.... kodiak camera.
If you don't stop, I'm going to leave some... brown... at your feet, human.

callisto_cub/legacy.text: You should get in the.... sun more.
One second, let me take a picture of you with my.... kodiak camera.
If you don't stop, I'm going to leave some... brown... at your feet, human.

vetion_jr/normal.text: Who is the true lord and king of the lands?
The mighty heir and lord of the Wilderness.
Where is he? Why hasn't he lifted your burden?
I have not fulfilled my purpose.
Not what is, what was. A great war tore this land apart and, for my failings in protecting this land, I carry the burden of its waste.

scorpias_offspring/.text: At night time, if I were to hold ultraviolet light over you, would you glow?
One, When has it ever been night time here?
Two, When have you ever seen ultraviolet light around here?
In answer to your question though. Yes I, like every scorpion, would glow.

nodes.text: Do you miss your people?
Mej-TzTok-Jad Kot-Kl! (TzTok-Jad will protect us!)
No.. I don't think so.
Jal-ZekKl? (Foreigner hurt us?)
No, no, I wouldn't hurt you.
Are you hungry?
Kl-Kra!
Ooookay...
Do you miss your people?
Mej-TzTok-Jad Kot-Kl! (TzTok-Jad will protect us!)

Jal-ZekKl? (Foreigner hurt us?)

Are you hungry?
Kl-Kra!
Ooookay...
How many souls have you devoured?
None.
Awww p-
Yet.
Oh.
What a cute puppy, how nice to meet you.
It'll be nice to meat you too...
Urk... nice doggy.
Grrrr....
Hell yeah! Such a cute puppy!
Silence mortal! Or I'll eat your soul.
Would that go well with lemon?
Grrrr....
Why were the hot dogs shivering?
Grrrrr...
Because they were served-
GRRRRRR...
-with... chilli?
I wonder if I need to invest in a trowel when I take you out for a walk.
More like a shovel.
Yeah, don't take it personally.
In his dying moment, my father poured his last ounce of strength into my creation. My being is formed from his remains.
When your own body is consumed to nourish the Nexus, and an army of scions arises from your corpse, I trust you will not take it personally either.
No, I am your father.
No, you are not.

heron/heron.text: Hop inside my mouth if you want to live!
I'm not falling for that... I'm not a fish! I've got more foresight than that.

heron/great blue heron.text: Haven't you already eaten enough Spirit flakes?
Yes, I have. That's why I'm asking you for raw fish.
Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.

rock_golem/rock.text: So you're made entirely of rocks?
Not quite, my body is formed mostly of minerals.
No, rocks are rocks, minerals are minerals. I am formed from minerals.
Yes, I am. This conversation seems to be confusing you; perhaps you should stop.

rock_golem/tin.text: I feel strangely emotionless and empty. Maybe I should feel sad about it, but I can't.
Correct. Now, if I only had a heart...
I'm not sure it works like that around here.

rock_golem/copper.text: I have an idea for a song.
Copper-copper-copper Cophelia - you come and go, you come and go...

rock_golem/iron.text: Truth is, I am Iron Golem.

rock_golem/blurite.text: I have an idea for a song.

rock_golem/silver.text: Oh dear, I've gone all pale.
It must be something I ate.

rock_golem/coal.text: So near and yet so far... if my atoms were arranged a little differently, I could be diamond.
Would you enjoy being a diamond?
I expect I would, until someone tried chipping bits off me with a chisel. I'm probably safer as coal.

rock_golem/gold.text: I'm totally showing the bling today.
A little. Though sometimes I just feel like I'm being used as a status symbol, and no-one appreciates me for me.
Don't worry. At least I look good.

rock_golem/mithril.text: I feel sad today. Very blue.

rock_golem/granite.text: I know how it works. No-one actually wants granite. They just chop us up and throw our pieces on the floor.
Oh, I can see that must be upsetting for you.
When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.

rock_golem/adamantite.text: I may be green, but I'm not an environmentalist.
There's no need. Whatever you may have read, even coal is a renewable energy source - just wait a minute and the rocks respawn.
You can burn as much as you like, too, without needing to worry about it affecting the climate - we don't have a lot of weather here.
Yes, I pity anyone whose world doesn't work like this one. I don't know how they can possibly cope.

rock_golem/runite.text: I'm confused. It takes incredible skill to smith anything from my ore, yet the items you'd get are terribly mediocre.
Is that something that worries you?
It just feels like my world doesn't make sense, sometimes. But I suppose it's always been like this, and I've got used to it.

rock_golem/amethyst.text: Your world is amazing. I truly am in awe.
Did you just make an ore joke?
Ha! Now you're making them as well.
Are we really doing this? Amethyst isn't an ore anyway.

rock_golem/lovakite.text: So how do you pronounce Lovakengj?
How did you not know that?
You know, it really isn't that obvious.

rock_golem/elemental.text: I am so in my element right now.

rock_golem/daeyalt.text: Did you ever hear the tragedy of Queen Efaritay the Fair?
It's not a story the Myreque would tell you.

beaver/normal.text: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
Approximately 32,768 depending on his woodcutting level.

beaver/oak.text: What did the oak tree drop?

beaver/teak.text: Can we teak a break? My legs are tired.

beaver/maple.text: Why do maple trees not try to explore new lands?

beaver/mahogany.text: If you had a pet pig, you could call it ma-hog-eat-any.

beaver/arctic pine.text: Is there anything I can't eat?

beaver/yew.text: Yew are too kind, my furry little friend.

beaver/magic.text: Anything I can do to cheer you up?
A dam and some logs could be some fun....

beaver/redwood.text: It sure is hard to cut the top off of a redwood tree... You can't take any short cuts!
Why do I even try talking to you.

nodes.text: I can't believe people try to eat us.
What would you taste like? Chicken?
I'd taste fowl, you wouldn't like it at all...
What's the Freaky Forester like?
You mean the odd fellow who recruits random adventurers to butcher an exorbitant amount of my kind daily in exchange for his spare clothing?
Why yes, he's simply delightful...
You look a bit on edge. Are you okay?
I have the strangest urge to run infront of a fast moving adventurer...
...maybe if we all made an underground village together...
What are you pondering, my furry friend?
Oh, just a grand plan to save all the wildlife from being hunted.
That is quite fantastic, fox!
Hello fox, what do you say?
I do wish people would stop asking me that!
I'm famished! Do you have any food?
I'm sure we could find you something.
How about we visit a chicken coop to, uh, admire the scenery!
I better find you something to eat quickly.
How come I can talk to you without an amulet?
*Woof woof bark!* Elementary, it's due to the influence of the -SQUIRREL-!
Walkies!
Can you help me with this clue?
*Woof! Bark yip woof!* Sure! Eliminate the impossible first.
And then?
*Bark! Woof bark bark.* Whatever is left, however improbable, must be the answer.
So helpful.
I wonder if I could sell you to a vampyre to track down dinner.
*Woof bark bark woof* I have teeth too you know, that joke was not funny.
Hey boy, what's up?
*Woof! Bark bark woof!* You smell funny.
Err... funny strange or funny ha ha?
*Bark bark woof!* You aren't funny.
So how come you are so agile?
If you were so nutty about nuts, maybe you would understand the great lengths we go to!

How are you doing today?
The power of the Abyss grows. I fear for what will happen if our defence against it fails.
The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.
Let us hope you are correct.
*Whistles*
You slip your hand into Rocky's pocket.
OY!! You're going to have to do better than that! Sheesh, what an amateur.
Is there much competition between you raccoons and the magpies?
Magpies have nothing on us! They're just interested in shinies.
Us raccoons have a finer taste, we can see the value in anything, whether it shines or not.
Hey Rocky, do you want to commit a bank robbery with me?
If that is the level you are at, I do not wish to participate in criminal acts with you [player name].
Well what are you interested in stealing?
The heart of a lovely raccoon called Rodney.
I cannot really help you there I'm afraid.
Hi Rocky, how are you?
Your shoe laces are untied!
Rocky jumps into your backpack...
The master thief strikes again! Here you go, have it back.
Rocky flicks the coin back into your backpack
I better keep my eyes on you...
Have you ever seen a blue panda before?
Blue Panda? That's ridiculous, there's only one type of panda and it is a beautiful red.
Hey Red, hows it going?
Hi! Want to see me do a really fast cartwheel?
Uh, yeah, sure go ahead.
Nothing happens...
Want to see me do it again?
Huh? Nothing happened...
To your eyes...
Do you know a raccoon called Dufresne?
No, I don't believe I have.
Hey Ziggy, do you have any relation to a raccoon named Rocky?
Who me? No, me and Rocky are not related.
Really? But you look so similar.
That's because a Tanuki is a master of disguise! I could pretend to be a human if I wanted to.
Wow! Why don't you do it now then?
I said if I wanted to, I don't want to.
Hey Ziggy, *giggles* do you happen to know any good plumbers?
Well that's a bit of a silly question isn't it.
What do you mean?
Why would I, a Tanuki, know any good plumbers?
I don't know, you might have come across one before.
Well, clearly not, since I spend most of my time following you around.
Ziggy! I've got a treat for you!
Really! Where! Let me have it!
You hold out your fist.
Why are you hiding it? Let me have it! Please, please, please!
You open your fist... there is no treat.
Oh, where did the treat go? Did you drop it?
Yeah, I must have dropped it, sorry about that Ziggy.
So... The Pyromancers, they're cool, right?
We share a common goal.
Which is?
Keeping the cinders burning and preventing the long night from swallowing us all.
That sounds scary.
As long as we remain vigilant and praise the Sun, all will be well.
... What are you staring at?
The great Sol Supra.
Is that me?
No mortal. The Sun, as you would say.
Do you worship it?
It is wonderous... If only I could be so grossly incandescent.
Who's a pretty birdy?
The phoenix gives you a smouldering look.
One day I will burn so hot I'll become Sacred Ash.
Aww, but you're so rare, where would I find another?
Do not fret mortal, I will rise from the Sacred Ash greater than ever before.
So you're immortal?
As long as the Sun in the sky gives me strength.
...Sky?

olmlet/olmlet.text: Hee hee! What shall we talk about, human?

opts.label: Where do creatures like you come from?

nodes.text: Where do creatures like you come from?
From eggs, of course! You can't make an olmlet without breaking an egg.
That's... informative. Thank you.
Hee hee! What's next, human?
You look like a dragon.
And humans look like monkeys. Badly shaved monkeys. What's your point, human?
Are you related to dragons?
My sire was an olm. I'm an olm. I don't go around asking you about your parents' species, do I?
... no, I suppose you don't.
Hee hee! Let's change the subject before someone gets insulted. What shall we talk about instead, human?

opts.label: Can you tell me secrets about your home?

nodes.text: Can you tell me secrets about your home?
Ooh, it was lovely. I lived in an eggshell. I was safe in there, dreaming of the life I would lead when I hatched, and the caverns I could rule.
Then suddenly I felt a trembling of the ground, and my shell shattered.
Through its cracks I saw the world for the first time, just in time to watch my sire die.
It was a terrible shock for a newly hatched olmlet, but I try not to let it affect my mood. So what else shall we talk about, human?
Maybe another time.
What lovely teeth you have!
All the better for chomping stuff.
WOW! No chill?
Hey, its a dog-eat-dogadile world out there!
Want to play fetch?
Play meat!
No, fetch... you know, I throw stick and you bring it back?
You fetch meat.
It doesn't just grow on trees you know!
Om nom nom good meat.
You look hot.
Heat required for forge.
What are you making?
Heat.
Well, forge ahead then.
What are you-
STOP!
HAMMER TIME!

olmlet/vanguard.text: Learn ye of the Judgement of the Vanguard. The form we have taken.
But you're so little and cute!
Learn ye this form was not given from the grace of our Lord Xeric. He does not forgive those who choose poorly.

olmlet/vasa minirio.text: The Dark Altar! The power it has given. Xeric, you cannot comprehend!
I will take Kourend for myself, for I am no longer the priest. I am the god!

nodes.text: Hello
Bzzzzt!
Bzzz bzzz bzz?
Buzz off human.
It's you that's following me! Maybe I should invest in a large flyswat...
Bzzzzt!
Hello
Bzzzzt!
Bzzz bzzz bzz?
Buzz off human.
It's you that's following me! Maybe I should invest in a large flyswat...
Bzzzzt!
I do not thinke thou understand the depths of the darkness you have unleashed upon the world. To dub it in such a scintillant manner is offensive to mine being.
So why are you following me around?
Dark forces of which ye know nought have deemed that this is my geas.
Your goose?
*Sighs* Nae. But thine is well and truly cooked.
I am spawned of darkness. I am filled with darkness. I am darkness incarnate and to darkness I will return.
Sounds pretty... dark.
Knowest thou not of the cursed place? Knowest thou not about the future yet to befall your puny race?
Oh yes, I've heard that before.
Then it is good that ye can laugh in the face of the end.
The end has a face? Which end?
*Sighs* The darkness giveth, and the darkness taketh.

opts.label: What can you do for me?

nodes.text: Nothing. Ye are already tainted in my sight by the acts of light. However there may be some hope for you if you continue to aid the darkness.
I do have a lantern around here somewhere.
Do not bring that foul and repellant thing near mine self.
Yo Nib, what's going on?

nodes.text: Although they have wings, dragons rarely fly. This is because the animals they prey on are all ground dwelling.
Unlike their creators, dragons have the ability to reproduce. Like most reptiles, they are oviparous. This means that they lay eggs rather than birthing live young.
Dragons have a very long lifespan and can live for thousands of years. With a lifespan that long, most dragons die to combat instead of age.

While very closely related, dragons and wyverns are actually different species. You can easily tell the difference between them by counting the number of legs, dragons have four while wyverns have two.
Metallic dragons were created by inserting molten metal into the eggs of other dragons. Very few eggs survived this process.
The dragonkin created dragons by fusing their own lifeblood with that of a lizard. The dragonkin created other species in similar ways by using different types of reptile.
Dragons have the ability to speak. However, most dragons don't have the brain capacity to do it very well.
Dragons share their name with dragon equipment, which was also created by the dragonkin. This equipment is fashioned out of Orikalkum.
Although very aggressive, dragons do not typically stray from their own territory. They instead make their homes in places where there is plenty of prey to be found.

Dragons have a duct in their mouth from which they can expel various internally produced fluids. The most common of these is a fluid which ignites when it reacts with air. This is how dragons breathe fire.
